Asset type: premium raster hero artwork for the music elimination game LAST TRACK STANDING, to be placed beside real HTML headings in homepage and on winner screen. Generate a single square 1:1 image, no screen UI, NO text, no letters, no words, no numbers. Straight-on studio product rendering: beautiful large glossy black vinyl record standing upright on a low wide cylindrical black stone winner podium, a minimal crown symbol printed on its circular center label, two abstract record sleeves behind the record, thin tournament bracket connector lines fading into the background on both sides. The whole sculpture must fit inside frame with 10% margins. Dramatic and sophisticated but clean, realistic vinyl grooves and reflected highlights, microtexture, subtle studio light and sharp silhouette. No people, no real album covers, no logos. Background almost black #101211 blending to solid black at corners. The record is hero, the podium and bracket communicate one musical winner. Identity A ELECTRIC: vivid acid lime #D4FF46 is the ONLY chromatic accent, ivory and graphite supporting neutrals, lime center label with black crown, subtle acid rim light on black record and podium, sleeves in charcoal and desaturated ivory. Minimal editorial music magazine feel. No blue or orange.
